field_semantics.frontend_viewmodel: Current Flutter App implementation and acceptance status; mirrors app_status and does not imply runtime verification.
field_semantics.viewmodel_contract_status: Readiness of the ViewModel contract/design, separate from Flutter App implementation.
field_semantics.implementation_owner: Current delivery executor; CODEX here is not the capability owner.
field_semantics.source_status: Source classification for the specific recorded screen/field and its audited consumer. EXISTS_BUT_UNSCOPED means missing proven actor/Subject/BrandFocus data scoping, not exclusion from product scope. Verify current caller/source before reuse or deletion.
field_semantics.acceptance_status: Acceptance evidence for this recorded binding only. PENDING is not zero product progress or a complete count of all user outcomes; source, runtime and user-result verification remain separate.
